name: Glitchcan
description: FINK stories and games, the edot office apps and demos, as pages of one MiniApp.

req_permissions.name: system.permission.STORAGE
req_permissions.reason: Keep your documents, sheets, files and reading place in this browser

req_permissions.name: system.permission.AUDIO
req_permissions.reason: Play the sound in stories and games

req_permissions.name: foafos.story:link
req_permissions.reason: Let stories link to other stories

req_permissions.name: foafos.story:observe
req_permissions.reason: Let a story see the games it has opened

req_permissions.name: foafos.story:navigate
req_permissions.reason: Keep your place in a story in the address bar, so you can share it

req_permissions.name: foafos.vars:read
req_permissions.reason: Let a game read what you have found in a story

req_permissions.name: foafos.vars:write
req_permissions.reason: Let a game add what you win to the story
